id: \bThis is my spot. Get your own.
en: \bThis is my spot. Get your own.
it: \bQuesto è il mio posto. Trovatene uno tuo.

id: \bMinior are super rare. Someone like me has to get as many as I can.
en: \bMinior are super rare. Someone like me has to get as many as I can.
it: \bI Minior sono rarissimi. Uno come me deve prenderne il più possibile.

id: \bKukui: There you are cousin. We almost thought you got lost. You took so long you missed the tour. Let's all head back.
en: \bKukui: There you are cousin. We almost thought you got lost. You took so long you missed the tour.  Let's all head back.
it: \bKukui: Eccoti, cugino. Pensavamo quasi che ti fossi perso. Ci hai messo così tanto che ti sei perso la visita.  Torniamo tutti indietro.

id: \bKiawe: This area looks like a good place to relax.
en: \bKiawe: This area looks like a good place to relax.
it: \bKiawe: Questa zona sembra un buon posto per rilassarsi.

id: \bSophocles: My cousin, Molayne, works here. I come every now and then to see him.
en: \bSophocles: My cousin, Molayne, works here. I come every now and then to see him.
it: \bChrys: Mio cugino Molayne lavora qui. Ogni tanto vengo a trovarlo.

id: \bYou're impressed. I can tell by your stunned silence.
en: \bYou're impressed. I can tell by your stunned silence.
it: \bSei colpito. Lo capisco dal tuo silenzio sbalordito.

id: \bThere are some rare Minior in the grass over there.
en: \bThere are some rare Minior in the grass over there.
it: \bNell'erba laggiù ci sono dei Minior rari.

id: \rLana: This place is a little too barren.
en: \rLana: This place is a little too barren.
it: \rSuiren: Questo posto è un po' troppo desolato.
